t: Designed as an alternative to the traditional coach screw, mainly used for timber to timber applications. Wafer head for improved clamping and a low profile finish. Coated with a multi-layer corrosion-resistant plating to withstand 1000 hours salt spray test. Features lubrication designed to enhance screw insertion time. Ideal for external applications.
b: Wafer Head for a Low Profile Finish
Multi-Coating for Rust Resistance in Pressure-Treated Timber
